name: @cozea/devapp-api
description: Typed extension, native React renderer, and build APIs for Cozea DevApps.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts src/native.ts --outdir dist --format esm --target browser --external react && mkdir -p dist/shared && bun build src/shared/nativeDevAppManifest.ts --outfile dist/shared/nativeDevAppManifest.js --format esm --target browser && bun build src/builder.ts --outfile dist/builder.js --format esm --target bun && bunx tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
